ampersand.meaning: A symbol (&) representing the word "and" in written language.
ampersand.sentence: The ampersand is often used in company names.

blueprint.meaning: A detailed plan or design that explains how something will be built.
blueprint.sentence: The architect showed us the blueprint for the new house.

resilient.meaning: Able to recover quickly from difficulty or change.
resilient.sentence: The resilient team recovered after the setback.

run.sentence: I run every morning before work.

walk.meaning: To move at a regular pace by putting one foot in front of the other.
walk.sentence: We walk to school every morning.
